title: Crafter + Target + Copper Bulb Backport
description: This project backports the crafter block from 1.21+ updates and the target block from 1.16 update and the copper bulb whilst trying to make them as accurate as possible. I have also added a few QOL Additions like Shovels being able to turn dirt into path
body: This project backports the crafter block from 1.21+ updates and the target block from 1.16 update and the copper bulb whilst trying to make them as accurate as possible. I have also added a few QOL Additions like Shovels being able to turn dirt into grass path which was not possible in older versions of minecraft. Copper light bulbs oxidize just like in regular minecraft. All items are named as "minecraft:" to allow upgrading of the world in the future
